newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates lightly quoted on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates lightly quoted on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates remained thinly quoted on Thursday at the St. Louis Merchants Exchange. No barges traded on Thursday versus none on Monday.
The market was closed on December 31 and January 1.
- Two barges, next week, Illinois River, Pekin and South, bid 145 percent of tariff, no offer.
- One barge, constructive placement by 0700, January 3, MoundCity, Ill., $500 switched, bid 100 percent, no offer.
- Three barges, one each week of January 12-26, St Louis, Mississippi, no bid, offer 115 percent.
